metadata.title: Fitness OS Phase 16 Global Search, Favourites and Comparison Reference Data
metadata.notice: This file defines search, ranking, favourites, recents and comparison contracts. It contains no user queries, favourites, private notes or fabricated domain content.

stores.purpose: One canonical favourite per stable entity reference.
Local named collections of saved public or private references.
Ordered collection membership with optional local notes.
Optional local query history; never transmitted.
Optional local recently viewed entity history.
Saved comparison configurations, not copied factual content.
Search, history, privacy and display preferences.
Save, remove, clear, migrate, import and restore events.
Soft-deletion tombstones for local Phase 16 records.
Rebuildable on-device index for opted-in private records; excluded from backup.

entityRegistry.title: Reviewed warm-up, mobility or recovery routine

searchIndexContract.engineAdapter: MiniSearch-compatible local full-text adapter; pin exact version and keep replaceable.
searchIndexContract.privateArtifact: Rebuildable in-browser cache created only after explicit opt-in.
searchIndexContract.canonicalSource: Published repository-owned records from owning modules.
searchIndexContract.publicationGate: Only published records with valid routes and stable IDs enter the public index.
searchIndexContract.indexVersion: sha256 over canonical searchable documents plus adapter configuration.
searchIndexContract.loadStrategy: Load after idle or first search; use a dedicated worker if measured main-thread work exceeds the defined budget.
searchIndexContract.cachePolicy: Search caches are disposable and excluded from backups.

tieBreakers: earlier canonical entity-type priority only when user selected All
locale-aware title sort using one configured Intl.Collator

normalizationRules.aliasPolicy: Only aliases explicitly stored by owning modules or reviewed Phase 16 alias records are indexed.
normalizationRules.numericPolicy: Numeric and mixed alphanumeric tokens do not use fuzzy matching by default.

fuzzyRules.behavior: maximum one edit or explicit fuzzy ratio no greater than 0.15
maximum two edits or explicit fuzzy ratio no greater than 0.20
fuzzy disabled unless a reviewed alias explicitly covers the form

comparisonFamilies.title: Muscles
rules: Use current published versions.
Compare anatomy, functions, joint actions and linked exercises.
Do not rank muscles by importance, size or growth potential.

comparisonFamilies.title: Exercises
rules: Compare movement pattern, equipment, difficulty, muscle relationships, setup and constraints.
Do not claim one exercise is universally best.
Do not invent activation percentages.

comparisonFamilies.title: Workout programs
rules: Show goal, level, days, duration, equipment, progression, deload and substitutions.
Do not declare a universal winner.
Draft program identities are ineligible.

comparisonFamilies.title: Foods
rules: Use exact food profile and preparation state.
Missing nutrient values remain unavailable.
Serving comparison is enabled only when every selected profile has a verified gram weight.

comparisonFamilies.title: Nutrients
rules: Compare functions, forms, food sources and framework definitions.
Reference values can be compared only within the same framework, age, sex and life-stage selection.
Do not rank nutrient importance.

comparisonFamilies.title: Recipes
rules: Show recipe version, yield method, calculation grade and nutrient completeness.
Per-serving comparison requires explicit serving grams.
Do not compare unresolved recipes as exact nutrition.

comparisonFamilies.title: Recovery methods
rules: Require one selected outcome such as soreness, perceived recovery, strength, power or range of motion.
Keep evidence direction and confidence separate.
Do not create one recovery ranking.

comparisonFamilies.title: Cardio modalities
rules: Compare equipment, skill, impact, environment and trackable metrics.
Do not compare pace across different modalities.
Do not estimate calories or VO2max.

comparisonFamilies.title: Cardio plans
rules: Compare goal, level, duration, frequency, modality and progression.
Do not declare one plan universally superior.
Draft plans are ineligible.

comparisonFamilies.title: Supplement ingredients
rules: Require the same selected outcome and population context.
Show exact form, protocol source, evidence direction, confidence, safety and anti-doping status.
Never recommend a winner or product.

sources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
sources.note: Use WCAG 2.2 AA as the product target.

sources.title: WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices: Combobox Pattern
sources.note: Implement only after validating behavior with real keyboard and screen-reader tests.

sources.title: WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices: Modal Dialog Pattern
sources.note: Use for the global search dialog and destructive confirmation dialogs.

sources.title: WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices: Table Pattern
sources.note: Prefer native HTML tables for non-editable comparison data.

sources.title: Understanding WCAG 2.2 Success Criterion 4.1.3: Status Messages
sources.note: Result counts and important changes must be programmatically announced without stealing focus.

sources.title: IndexedDB API
sources.note: Canonical local records use IndexedDB. Rebuildable search caches are not canonical backups.

sources.title: Web Workers API
sources.note: Use a dedicated worker when index initialization or query execution would block the main thread.

sources.title: URLSearchParams
sources.note: Only public, non-sensitive state is placed in URLs.

sources.title: String.prototype.normalize()
sources.note: Normalize matching text without changing displayed canonical text.

sources.title: Intl.Collator
sources.note: Use a configured collator for deterministic title sorting after relevance ties.

sources.title: MiniSearch Documentation
sources.note: Pin an exact dependency version in the repository and preserve an adapter boundary so the library can be replaced.

sources.title: MiniSearch API Reference
sources.note: Do not rely on undocumented defaults; define all scoring and fuzzy options explicitly.

testVectors.purpose: Exact canonical title outranks exact alias and fuzzy matches.
testVectors.expected: canonical Bench press result is first when published

testVectors.purpose: An alias returns one canonical record rather than duplicate alias rows.
testVectors.expected: one canonical chickpea food record appears with alias-match explanation

testVectors.purpose: Short technical tokens avoid destructive typo expansion.
testVectors.expected: exact/prefix matches only; no unrelated fuzzy result

testVectors.purpose: Draft and quarantined records never appear in public search.
testVectors.expected: record absent from public index and suggestions

testVectors.purpose: Public search state survives refresh and back navigation.
testVectors.expected: same validated state after reload

testVectors.purpose: Personal notes and logs are never globally searched by default.
testVectors.expected: private record absent

testVectors.purpose: Private query text or record IDs are not written to the URL.
testVectors.expected: private mode uses local state; URL omits private text and private record IDs

testVectors.purpose: Typing and searching cause no external request.
testVectors.expected: zero runtime search or analytics network calls

testVectors.purpose: Incompatible entity types cannot share a comparison.
testVectors.expected: exercise rejected with an accessible explanation

testVectors.purpose: Food comparisons preserve state and basis.
testVectors.expected: distinct profile labels and no silent raw-to-cooked conversion

testVectors.purpose: Unavailable comparison values remain unavailable.
testVectors.expected: cell displays Not available and is excluded from difference calculations

testVectors.purpose: Supplement comparison cannot combine different outcomes or populations.
testVectors.expected: comparison blocked until one shared context is selected

testVectors.purpose: Removed content does not silently retarget a favourite.
testVectors.expected: favourite marked unavailable with remove and review actions

testVectors.purpose: Approved stable-ID migration can update a favourite transparently.
testVectors.expected: entity reference migrated, audit event written, user informed

testVectors.purpose: Stale serialized index is rebuilt rather than used silently.
testVectors.expected: index rejected and rebuilt from canonical search documents

testVectors.purpose: Search autocomplete follows keyboard interaction.
testVectors.expected: dialog opens, suggestion is announced, selection navigates, focus returns on close

testVectors.purpose: Result-count changes are announced without moving focus.
testVectors.expected: polite status message reports count and active filters

testVectors.purpose: Search highlighting cannot inject markup.
testVectors.expected: literal escaped text or rejected record; no HTML execution

testVectors.purpose: Compare tray enforces the family limit.
testVectors.expected: fifth item rejected with max-four explanation

testVectors.purpose: Rebuildable search indexes are not canonical backup data.
testVectors.expected: favourites and settings included; public/private search caches excluded
